description:
Parse the value of a query `assignee:` filter into an `Assignee`, so malformed filters fail instead of silently matching nothing.

## Background

`QueryCondition::Assignee` holds a `String` (`crates/jit/src/query_engine/parser.rs:39,142`), compared as a string by the evaluator (`query_engine/evaluator.rs:56-59,186,189`). A value without a colon, or `*`, parses and matches nothing. The query reference shows `NOT assignee:*` (`docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1227`), which therefore never matches.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `QueryCondition::Assignee` holds an `Assignee`, and an `assignee:` value that lacks a colon, or is `*`, is a parse error naming the value.
- [hard] REQ-02: The evaluator compares `Assignee` values.
- [hard] REQ-03: The query reference shows only working assignee filters, and its `NOT assignee:*` example is replaced by the unassigned filter.
title: Query assignee filters parse to an Assignee
